comment: What the room scripts don't say, for tools/routesim/sim.py. Flags are [bank, flag] (bank 0/1 scenario, 2 locks,
7 room items; flag n = bit 31 - n % 32 of word n / 32). Each entry names its source: a labelled flag in
data/games/re1/flag-labels.json, the decomp (facts), a live trace, or the walkthrough (facts only).

jill.why: live 2026-10-27: the harness's new game (the opening's recorded end applied), flags and inventory read the moment control starts in the dining room

gates.why: behind the wall the piano opens (flag-labels B[165])
past the plant the herbicide kills (flag-labels B[169])

behind the clock, which the room script moves aside only once the gold emblem is on the wall (B[171]: 105 init places object 2 at x 16000 instead of 18000); the clock's collision isn't read yet. Live 2026-10-27: the key can't be taken before
